objective.en: Map the glacier ice that survives the summer melt in the mountains east of Anchorage.

sources.name: NASA Terra MODIS NDSI snow cover (GIBS layer MODIS_Terra_NDSI_Snow_Cover)
sources.usage: Hazard cells = cells where Terra MODIS NDSI saw snow/ice (NDSI >= 40) on at least two clear days during the end of the summer 2024 melt season (20 August - 9 September 2024), i.e. ice that survived the summer melt; top 12% by persistence. Ice is present from day 0. The hazard cut-off is a game choice.

sources.name: Mission: Possible cloud and detectability model
sources.usage: cloudProbability (baseline 0.6 for this glacier setting) and detectability are seeded educational estimates, not observations.
